# Amir Raza — Shopify Expert & Meta Ads Specialist (Karachi, Pakistan)

> Amir Raza is a Shopify development and performance marketing specialist based in Karachi, Pakistan, working with ecommerce brands in Pakistan and internationally. Services: Shopify and WooCommerce store development, Facebook & Instagram (Meta) Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads, landing page & conversion rate optimization (CRO), ad creatives & brand design, ecommerce strategy, and Daraz store management. Pricing is discussed on a free consultation call.

Verified performance (from Meta Ads Manager account data, 14 Aug–11 Nov 2026): PKR 7.32M and US$2,227 in managed ad spend, 9,314 website purchases, 4.78X average Purchase ROAS and 8.53X highest verified Purchase ROAS (best campaign using at least 5% of its account's spend), across seven verified ad accounts for six ecommerce brands. Experience spans 30 ecommerce stores in 10+ industries.
